topic: The ocean is so deep that Mount Everest would vanish completely inside it
hook: The ocean is so deep, Everest would disappear inside it.
script: The ocean is so deep, Everest would disappear inside it. Mount Everest stands 8,849 metres tall. The Mariana Trench is 11,034 metres deep. If you dropped Everest into the trench, it would be covered by over a mile of water. We have better maps of Mars than the ocean floor. 80% of Earth's oceans remain unmapped. Follow for facts about the world hiding beneath us.
